summary: ING Groep filed a 6-K attaching a press release providing a routine weekly update on its ongoing €1.0 billion share buyback programme announced on 30 April 2026. During the week of 20–24 July 2026, 865,193 shares were repurchased at an average price of €28.83, for a total of €24.9 million. To date, 17,025,193 shares have been repurchased at an average price of €26.52, representing 45.16% of the programme's maximum total value. This is a standard capital return update, not a special situation event.
